question: Which goddesses protect the navel region and the head at all times?
premises: Sundarī is invoked for protection in the navel region
Kāmakalā is invoked for protection on the head
inference: Sundarī protects the navel region and Kāmakalā always protects the head
plain_english: May Sundarī protect in the navel region, and may Kāmakalā always protect on the head.
